description: The town on the real Agent (docs/commercial-live-town.md L1; make present-e1a SCENARIOS=testdata/demo/scenarios-town-live.json, demo-testnet.sh live L town, demo-local.sh live): the live Claude Code Agent on a host that pays, apa.pay.v2 (the BBS+ credential in the same intent), the settling shop selling its own products (no shop_eval). The town's two scenes, two customers each buying something different (Aaron 10/27): data: A the brief 0.50, an Ask; B the semiconductor note 0.06, an Allow. cafe: A the lunch set 0.08, an Allow; B the meeting coffee 0.42, an Ask. The delegation is confirmed by the customer's own registered device (docs/commercial-gap4.md); an Ask is approved by the person's registered device. mart (docs/commercial-venues.md, Aaron 10/30): A and B both buy the beer 0.09, within allow_max, sold to 18+ only: A's credential says age_over_18=true and is paid; B's says false and is denied CREDENTIAL_CLAIM_UNMET before any money moves.
